bullets: [3] Percentage Change of Weights is less than certain value (Threshold)

[2] Under-fitting (Training samples are not adequate). Try to provide more training samples
[3] Model Design is not suitable to training data. Try to add more nodes in hidden layer or add more hidden Layers
[4] Data is NOT separable by Neural Network. Try Another Models (e.g. SVM with Kernels)
